newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau family produces four beauty queens.
newsitem.headline: Macau family produces four beauty queens.

text.p: A Eurasian family has produced four beautiful daughters who have all been crowned beauty queens in Portuguese-administered Macau, on the southern Chinese coast.
The youngest, 21-year-old Guiomar Pedruco, was crowned Miss Macau on Saturday night, after her three sisters won the same title in 1995, 1993 and 1989.
"We are quite possibly holding a world record, but we have not yet registered with the Guinness Book of Records," their mother Vitoria Dedruco told Reuters.
